contract.task_clause:
A certain molecule acts by binding to cytochrome oxidase A3, the final enzyme in the electron transport chain. Administration of a large dose of this substance to a human would likely:
Option A: Lead to death due to an inability of the cell to pass electrons to oxygen, thus stopping aerobic respiration and asphyxiating the cells.
Option B: Lead to death due to an inadequate supply of ADP to accept a phosphate group at the ATP synthase enzyme.
Option C: Have no effect as cells would switch which macronutrient they metabolize to circumvent the blocked biochemical pathway.
Option D: Increase the cell’s ATP production as negative feedback would cause the cell to up-regulate anaerobic pathways.
